summary: Star Holdings filed an 8-K reporting that its wholly-owned subsidiary STAR Investment Holdings SPV LLC, as borrower, entered Amendment No. 5 to its margin loan agreement with Morgan Stanley entities on October 9, 2026. The amendment cuts the Safehold share-price trigger for mandatory prepayment from $10.00 to $8.00, terminates an undrawn $15.8 million delayed-draw commitment, and lowers loan-to-value thresholds for collateral posting or release. The facility had roughly $46.5 million outstanding, secured by a first-priority pledge of Safehold shares. This is a routine credit-facility amendment, not a special situation; watch collateral headroom and refinancing risk.
